title: AbyssiteOre
description: Adds abyssite to the game, a cool new ore.
body:
Abyssite Ore adds a powerful new material to Minecraft: Abyssite.
Forged from a Nether Star, 4 Diamonds, and 4 Iron Blocks, Abyssite is a late-game resource designed for players who have conquered the Whiter and are ready for something stronger. This mod brings new tools for progression and convinience for the true endgame survival.
